ideas.pitch: An intelligent multi-agent teaching and learning ecosystem where autonomous agents collaborate to generate personalized learning paths and grade student performance.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Multi-Agent Teaching and Learning Ecosystem
ideas.title: AgentEd-MultiAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a multi-agent student support platform architecture inspired by proven hackathon winners, directly addressing a core challenge with a clear, demonstrable working prototype.

ideas.pitch: An adaptive learning and knowledge gap identification system that analyzes student quiz responses in real-time to pinpoint specific misconceptions and inject tailored remediation.
ideas.problem_statement: Adaptive Learning and Knowledge Gap Identification System
ideas.title: GapTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-utility educational analytics and clear measurable impact for students and educators during the live pitch.

ideas.pitch: A smart crop disease prediction and management system utilizing crop imagery and environmental data to deliver localized prevention alerts to farmers.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Crop Disease Prediction and Management System
ideas.title: AgriPredict-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with concrete environmental data to show immediate social and economic benefits for agriculture.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent early health-risk detection and decision support system that analyzes patient vital signs and symptoms to highlight critical conditions.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Early Health-Risk Detection and Decision Support System
ideas.title: VitalGuard-Decision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-stakes medical domain with rigorous risk scoring and real-time decision support, aligning with judges' preference for life-impact projects.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous threat detection and situational awareness system that processes incoming logs and alerts to isolate security incidents.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Threat Detection and Situational Awareness System
ideas.title: DataSentinel-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an autonomous incident response workflow proven to win competitive engineering hackathons by solving difficult backend data problems.
